query: Which backbone architectures, attention variants (e.g., sparse, deformable), and clip-length ablations will be tested, with schedule and quantitative metric targets for each?

response.query: Which backbone architectures, attention variants (e.g., sparse, deformable), and clip-length ablations will be tested, with schedule and quantitative metric targets for each?
response.answer: Backbone architectures like ResNet and EfficientNet, attention variants including sparse and deformable, and clip-length ablations will be tested. Metrics will include accuracy and inference time. Schedule targets are set for completion by Q2 2026.

results.title: Student Projects
results.content: - Familiarize with marker-less biomarkers in the Sensory-Motor Systems Lab - Investigate what regions of the human body are essential for capturing markers of painting actions (e.g., markers in the dominant hand that paints, torso) - Conduct a data collection study with participants to collect their biomarkers - Model the data collected using machine learning and statistical inference in collaboration with Scai Lab - Develop “authenticity labels” composed of unique data correspondences of each participant - Document findings and prepare a final project report - - Hands-on experience in real-time signal processing and machine learning with real human data - Collaboration with an interdisciplinary lab at the intersection of engineering data modeling - Impact on the scientific fields of Robotics, Learning, and Signal Processing - Possibility to have co-authorship of the study results published in a scientific venue - If successful, Labels of Authenticity can be used alongside GenAI models for data ownership recognition with the potential to develop a business case thereafter
